subject: RE: Question about changing banks
text:
Hi Melissa,

Thanks for walking me through that. Given the callback and second-approval steps, we've decided not to move our receiving account after all; it isn't worth the disruption for our customers. Please keep everything as is. We'll stay with Chase.

Carla

> On Fri, Nov 6, 2026, Melissa Grant <mgrant@larkspur-ind.com> wrote:
> Hi Carla, if Brightline does change banks, we'll need a signed request on letterhead, and we'll call you back at the number in our vendor file before making any change. Payments would be held until that's done.
>
>> On Thu, Nov 5, 2026, Carla Benson <cbenson@brightlineoffice.com> wrote:
>> Hi Melissa, our treasurer is considering moving us to a different bank next year. Hypothetically, what would your process be if we did?
label: ordinary
note: Borderline: the thread discusses a possible bank change, but the earliest message is only a hypothetical question and the latest message decides against it. No request to send payments elsewhere is ever made.
